neighbours.label: ' more' as an added-quantity comparative inside a clause (even more, prevent more, a lot more)
fire: The new bridge will make the island an even more popular destination for tourists.
Doctors may prescribe tablets later to stop more clots from forming in the legs.
After the storm the farmers had to buy more seed than they had planned.
Our neighbours said they would read a lot more if the library opened on Sundays.
The council hopes the park will attract more families during the summer months.
With the new engine the boat became far more efficient on long crossings.
She told the class that practice makes the piano sound more natural over time.
The company plans to hire more nurses before the winter season begins.
quiet: The new bridge will make the island an even busier destination for tourists.
Doctors may prescribe tablets later to stop new clots from forming in the legs.
After the storm the farmers had to buy extra seed than they had planned.
Our neighbours said they would read every day if the library opened on Sundays.
The council hopes the park will attract young families during the summer months.
With the new engine the boat became far quieter on long crossings.
She told the class that practice makes the piano sound natural over time.
The company plans to hire several nurses before the winter season begins.

notes: Card: ' more' is the commonest peak token (7/32) but the top items are mixed (Verkauf, украшением, ' are', ' ='); broad weak pole.
